steps.text: In a medium mixing bowl combine cream cheese and butter, mixing until well blended. Add parsley, onion and garlic and mix well.
Refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours. The mixture becomes more flavorful the longer it chills.

raw_recipe.headline: Garlic Spread
raw_recipe.description: Butter combined with cream cheese and flavored with fresh parsley, onion and garlic.
raw_recipe.name: Garlic Spread

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium mixing bowl combine cream cheese and butter, mixing until well blended. Add parsley, onion and garlic and mix well.
Refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours. The mixture becomes more flavorful the longer it chills.

review.reviewBody: I scaled this recipe to 4 servings and increased the garlic substantially (used 2 cloves). It was really flavorful after sitting in the refrigerator a few hours. My wife and I both loved it on Ritz crackers. I used real butter which I think gave it a rather hard consistency. Next time I may try using whipped margarine instead. I don't think you can go wrong playing with this recipe and adjusting it to your individual liking.Good stuff Natalia.

I followed the others and added more garlic. I softened the cream cheese and butter in the microwave. I made a garlic and broccoli pizza. I spread the dough, added the garlic spread ( I needed it like now so I didn't but in the fridge but next time I will), added the broccoli then mozzarella cheese and sprinkled garlic salt and red pepper flakes on top . It was a hit. Hubby and the kids loved it.

This was awesome the first time I made it. But the second time I made it I sauted the garlic in the butter in a pan then mixed everything together (warm butter helped soften the cream cheese too) and it was absolutly great. Of course I added more garlic too.

This was SOOO good! I'm a huge fan of garlic, so I added an extra small clove and it was still super good. I used another reviewers advice and made it the night before to let the flavors meld. It was a hit!
Great spread!! My family loved it. I made a few changes. I used roasted garlic, added oregano, and a little onion and garlic salt season. Fantastic!!!

Wow, this was excellent! I made half a recipe just to try it, but added 2 cloves of garlic and even some garlic powder. I used soft-spread butter (worked great) so it would be ready to spread on a Ritz cracker whenever I wanted one, and also used dried minced onion flakes. This will NOT be going out with other appetizers when the family come for their Christmas visit! :) Thanks CKBK for the recipe!

Excellent. I followed another reviewer and melted the butter with the garlic then added it a little bit at a time, stirring between each addition. To turn this into a dip instead of a spread, i let this set in the fridge for a day or so to really let all the flavors meld together. My picky two yr old loves this dip with crackers.

5.31.21 This certainly is very creamy and spreadable, but I was expecting more garlic flavor. I added more garlic, but would add even more next time. Refrigerating definitely intensifies the flavor, so plan accordingly. Be sure to take out of the fridge about 30 minutes before serving to allow the spread to soften. Still enjoyable with a red wine marinara and homemade meatballs.
I only used 6 Tbs. butter and sauted the garlic and onion first. I used this recipe to stuff swwet mini peppers. Yum on Ritz crackers also...yum.
I halved the recipe and added 2 cloves of dried minced garlic. partially toasted the bread first. Even DS who does not like garlic liked it:)

Awesome! So creamy! We put this one Ciabatta split horizontally and baked in the oven. I used chive and onion cream cheese. The chive added color and flavor and I will not add the parley next time because of this. I also reduced the onion and garlic since flavoring was in the cream cheese already. (94)
Excellent recipe. I didn't feel like cutting up onions so I added onion salt.. great flavor
Absolutely love this stuff! It is so quick and easy to make. we use it on French bread when we have spaghetti or lasagne, then use the leftover spread on veggie dishes.
it was so good
Perfect! Entire family loved it even the picky kids. Much better than buying the garlic bread with the spread on it at the store.

LOVE IT! it is so gooey and yummy! good as store bought, if not better! btw, when you spread the garlic butter on the bread, put hot water on the knife you intend to use then, spread on, bake, and enjoy!!!
this was so yummy...used it for my garlic bread and will keep on using this recipe thats for sure...

Wow. I did use a big clove of garlic which was more like 2 regular cloves. I used dried parsley since I didnt have fresh on hand. I couldnt decide if we would like this better spread on the bread and then baked or put on after so I made both ways. Both ways are good but something about a light smear of this over the bread and then baking it made it amazing. I made this with spaghetti but it would help richen up a cheaper pasta dish like spaghetti, butter, garlic and parm. Excellent.

I made this spread in a pinch. I had all of the ingredients and used it immediately. The garlic taste was mild compared to the smell so I added garlic powder. Instead of using butter I used margarine. I only gave it three stars because of the mild taste. I will remake it with butter and less cream cheese. Thanks for the recipe.

I am really confused with some of the reviews left. they mention "onions" and " this is great warm right out of the oven". The recipe submitted does not list any of those items or instructions for baking in oven. Please explain or is the recipe not printed correctly??
